description: Whether an import into an EU member state falls under EU plant health control (phytosanitary certificate under Reg. (EU) 2016/2031 and 2019/2072 Annex XI/XII) and which other sanitary/phytosanitary and technical requirements apply, for a 10-digit CN/TARIC code and origin country, from the European Commission's Access2Markets service, with the national plant health authority and laws. EU imports only. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

code.description: 10-digit CN/TARIC code (8 digits are padded with 00), e.g. 0805102200 (fresh sweet oranges)

destination.description: EU member state alpha-2, e.g. DE, NL, FR (default DE)

origin.description: ISO alpha-2 country of origin outside the EU, e.g. TR, MA, CN
